test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Avadh starts from Point F and drives 5 km towards the west. He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 5 km. Then he takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point D. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point F from Point D? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
**Given:** All turns are 90 degree turns only

Avadh starts from Point F and drives 5 km towards the west.

He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 5 km.

Then he takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de78b91800068308ca5809ce7f3abd02cec7dca32acb91446b981a3874bcd5f8.png] 

Thus, Awadh is (5 + 2) = 7km away in the south direction from Point D to reach Point F.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
